lines: At action-power's end all stands as effect;
until it enters the unsurpassable, the prior holds —
essence of consciousness, mere light, the point: am.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ punaḥ kriyāśaktyante sarvaṃ kāryabhūtaṃ yāvat anuttare pravekṣyati tāvad eva pūrvaṃ saṃvedanasāratayā prakāśamātratvena bindutayā āste am iti

reads_against.argmap: What stands at kriyāśaktyanta before anuttara-entry? → am is the bindu-state: all-effect pending, standing as prakāśa-mātra at the threshold of anuttara.
c1_essence: At action-power's end all stands as effect — the prior standing as point, am, until unsurpassable entry.
